collection.observed_execution_deviation: All three conditions were launched concurrently instead of being started only after the previous condition had exited and been blind-scored.
collection.isolation_limit: The native subagents shared a filesystem. Their supplied workspaces excluded hidden/reference trees, but this was not OS or container isolation.

invalidation.reason: The V2 preregistration fixes a three-condition order for each task, but the first task's three agents were launched concurrently. The analyzer did not yet require a predecessor-score credential, so it could not independently detect this execution violation.
invalidation.effect_on_interpretation: The partial outcomes are preserved as diagnostics only. They must not be completed, retried, statistically analyzed, or used as Skill-effect, repair-success, or causal-capability evidence.

next_protocol_requirement: A successor corpus must use fresh task IDs and a frozen runner/analyzer that require every later condition to carry the SHA-256 digest of the prior condition's blind score before it can be prepared.
